notes: Research of 15 AUR packages for Guix feasibility: 3D slicers, synths, Wayland compositors, gaming platforms, IDE managers, proxies, font configs, udev rules, screen daemons, and C libraries.

packages.description: G-code generator for 3D printers (Bambu, Prusa, Voron, VzBot, RatRig, Creality, etc.)
packages.feasibility: HARD - Large C++ project with many dependencies including libigl, bundled deps, webkit2gtk. CMake build is complex with custom dep fetching. AGPL-3.0 is FOSS. Doable but substantial packaging effort.

packages.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (with non-commercial plugin exception; Component Library CC BY-NC 4.0)
packages.feasibility: HARD - GPLv3 core is FOSS but Component Library graphics are CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-free). Custom Makefile build with many bundled deps. The NC graphics license means Guix proper would exclude those assets. Source build possible but license complications.

packages.description: Fork of the sway Wayland compositor with a scrolling layout like PaperWM or niri
packages.feasibility: MEDIUM - MIT license, standard meson build, clean C project. Similar to packaging sway itself. Static wlroots linking in recent versions. Many Wayland deps already in Guix. Lua integration adds one extra dep. Very packageable.

packages.description: Open Gaming Platform (Live version - latest git snapshot as binary)
packages.feasibility: EASY - Lutris is already available in many distros. Pure Python with meson build. GPL-3.0 FOSS. Note: lutris-live-bin is just a snapshot of git master packaged as binary. For Guix, package from source release tags. Lutris is already in Guix upstream.

packages.description: Manage all your JetBrains Projects and Tools
packages.feasibility: NO - Proprietary software. No source code available. Custom JetBrains license, not FOSS. Cannot be packaged for Guix proper (nonfree). Could go in a nonfree channel only.

packages.description: A proxy server to bypass Cloudflare protection
packages.feasibility: HARD - MIT license is FOSS, but depends on undetected-chromedriver and a full Chromium browser at runtime. The Chromium dependency and selenium/webdriver chain makes this very hard to package cleanly for Guix. Docker is the intended deployment.

packages.description: Rename your TV-Series using TheTVDB (GTK2 version)
packages.feasibility: NO - Closed-source freeware. Source code not available. Developer explicitly declined to open-source it. Cannot be packaged for Guix (nonfree, no source).

packages.description: Container runtime with VM-like isolation (run Systemd, Docker, K8s in containers)
packages.feasibility: HARD - Apache-2.0 FOSS. Go project with multiple subcomponents (sysbox-runc, sysbox-fs, sysbox-mgr). Requires kernel features (user namespaces, shiftfs/idmapped mounts). Complex system-level software tightly coupled to container runtimes. Doable but requires deep system integration.

packages.description: Append noto-fonts-cjk to noto-fonts according to the locale
packages.feasibility: TRIVIAL/UNNECESSARY - This just installs a fontconfig XML snippet (70-noto-cjk.conf). In Guix, fontconfig is configured via system/home services. This would be a trivial font-config snippet, but Guix handles font ordering differently. Likely unnecessary as a standalone package.
packages.guix_build_system: trivial-build-system (or just a Guix fontconfig service snippet)

packages.description: The Gram Code Editor (Zed fork without AI, telemetry)
packages.feasibility: HARD - FOSS licenses. Rust/Cargo project forked from Zed. Massive crate dependency tree (Zed-scale). Requires vulkan, nodejs/npm at build time. Source build is possible but vendoring hundreds of Rust crates is the main challenge. Binary repack is easier but not Guix style.

TRIVIAL - Just a udev rules file for a USB DAC/AMP device. BSD license. In Guix, udev rules are typically provided via system services or as part of device packages. Could be a trivial package or a udev-rules-service snippet.

packages.description: JPEG XL image format reference implementation documentation (noglycin variant)
packages.feasibility: UNNECESSARY - libjxl is already packaged in Guix. The -noglycin variant exists because Arch removed pixbuf loaders; this is an Arch-specific workaround. The -doc output is just doxygen docs from the same source. Guix already has libjxl; docs can be added as an output.

packages.description: Easily convert terminal output into SVG images
packages.feasibility: HARD - Apache-2.0 FOSS. C#/.NET project. Guix has limited .NET/dotnet support. Source build requires dotnet SDK which is not well-supported in Guix. Binary repack of the self-contained linux-x64 binary would work but is not idiomatic Guix.
packages.guix_build_system: dotnet (not well supported in Guix) or binary-build-system

packages.description: Bus interface to change screen brightness, capture webcam frames, and manage screen temperature
packages.feasibility: MEDIUM - GPL-3.0 FOSS. Clean C project with cmake. Depends on libmodule (also FOSS, see #15). Depends on systemd-libs (Guix uses elogind/shepherd instead). Polkit integration needed. The systemd dependency is the main Guix challenge; may need elogind adaptation.

packages.description: C simple and elegant implementation of an actor library for modular projects
packages.feasibility: EASY - MIT license. Pure C library with zero external dependencies. Simple cmake build. Small codebase. Perfect candidate for Guix packaging. Prerequisite for clightd (#14).
